# Data-Shape Precision

Structured outputs must match specifications exactly.

## Parsing

Infer field meanings from samples in the actual inputs—never from guesses about “typical” layouts.

## Counting

Use structured filters or precise predicates for categorical tallies; substring tricks over-count.

## Boundaries

Apply date or numeric ranges exactly as stated; state whether endpoints are inclusive.

## Spot checks

After writing, read back ends of files and spot-check rows against expectations.
